name.zh: 史黛菈告知真相与席琉斯选择拯救奎多兰
name.en: Stella warns the palace and Sirius chooses to save Quedland

periods.summary: Stella manifests flame wings, breaks into the sealed palace, and tells Sirius, Astrea, and Dandallion that Quedland is under Or-Gaule's puppet control. Astrea argues that telling the front line would make soldiers hesitate and endanger Vermillion lives, but Sirius calls General Signa anyway and orders the army not to kill Quedland soldiers. He declares that Vermillion will value friendship and obligation over cold reason and save Quedland, preserving thirty years of reconciliation.
periods.cause: Quedland's controlled army is invading Vermillion, and the royal family must decide whether to treat them as enemies or victims.
periods.process: Stella flies over palace security and reports Or-Gaule's control, Clef's murder, and John being used. Astrea explains the rational state-duty argument for withholding the truth. Sirius rejects that logic, orders Signa to evacuate civilians and withdraw without killing, and then commits the whole country to saving Quedland. Astrea accepts and turns the discussion to tactics. Dandallion explains Fantasy Form will not work on puppets; Stella and Alice identify the relay-node principle, and Ikki proposes becoming the army's aerial eyes.
periods.outcome: Vermillion adopts an almost impossible nonlethal defense plan. Sirius formally frames Ikki's battlefield contribution as proof that he may become part of Vermillion's family.
periods.significance: Defines Vermillion's national identity as a country built on情义 rather than pure state logic, and sets up the Caldia relay-node operation.
